producer_report.summary: The critic brief now has a '## Challenge' section telling the critic to search for ways the plan's conclusions might be wrong: counterexamples, fragile assumptions and failure modes. OLY-8-05 in docs/spec.toml names that mechanism together with critic_round, keeps owner Ares, and its measure ends with 'status: planning'. A new test in briefs.rs checks the section and its key phrases. It passes now, and it would fail without the section, since the brief had no such text before. I ran that test, `cargo fmt --check` and the policy scan, and all passed. I did not run clippy or the full test suite. CHANGELOG.md has an entry for the change.
